label: eROSITA/eRASS3 Main
name: eROSITA-DE DR2 eRASS:3 Main
description: The eROSITA space X-ray telescope, operated by the German eROSITA Consortium (eROSITA-DE), has released its second data set (DR2) from the SRG/eROSITA all-sky survey. The eRASS:3 main catalogue stacks the first three survey passes over the Western Galactic Hemisphere and contains 1,975,540 X-ray sources detected with eSASS in the 0.2-2.3 keV band (detection likelihood above 6), with ML fluxes, rates and counts in the main band and nine sub-bands, corrected positions with uncertainties, extent measurements, quality flags, and cross-identifications to eRASS1, the eRASS:3 hard catalogue, 5XMM, Chandra CSC 2.1 and ROSAT 2RXS. The default column set is the 40 identifier, position, extent, main-band and flag columns; all 250 columns are available with columns='all'.
